_provenance: HAND-AUTHORED declared source for the INDUSTRY-CASES model — the book's external-evidence base as a mechanically-checkable model (not prose accumulated ad hoc). This file IS edited by hand; it is the single source of truth for the industry cases the book reads MAGE against: the reconciled correspondence taxonomy, the declared ordered CONSTRUCT UNIVERSE (the matrix column set), the fixed DocAble row-0 correspondence, the six-site ROSTER (declared intent), and the case RECORDS (Cloudflare authored + five pending-writeup stubs). Sibling in the book-models declared->generated idiom (see theory_of_mage_declared.json / metrics-dashboard.json). WIRED: industry_cases_model.py derives a typed model, projects the DocAble+authored correspondence matrix (render_matrix_md), runs the live queries (constructs / bears-on / only-docable / coverage / roster), and checks the joins IC1-IC6 status-aware. Lands AUDIT-ONLY-first in catalog.py validate (rule-#55 blocking-lint landing discipline); a later follow-up flips IC1-IC6 to BLOCKING after a clean session confirms the drain. Regen discipline: edit HERE; the queries and matrix compute live at CLI time (NO materialized industry-cases.json — page-parity + compute-at-CLI only, per the design's REVISE-2).
_intent: Encode external practitioner reports as a queryable MODEL so the book can ask its evidence base questions — which MAGE constructs have external observation, which cases bear on which hypothesis, where the base is still only DocAble — and project a drift-gated correspondence matrix, dogfooding the Modeling Thesis on the manuscript's own substantiation. One record per case; the matrix is append-a-row per authored case (a new CASE never widens the table; a new CONSTRUCT is the rare deliberate event that does — the declared construct-universe column contract, REVISE-3).
hedge: These cases are practitioner reports, not replications of MAGE and not causal tests. A correspondence cell states how cleanly the source's described behavior maps onto a MAGE construct as the BOOK reads it — never a claim Cloudflare (or any site) makes about MAGE, and never proof. `not-described` means the SOURCE is silent; absence from a report is NOT evidence the company lacks the practice.

_taxonomy._note: The controlled vocabularies. The CORRESPONDENCE set is the reconciled closed set (author's 5-value set): Phase-1's `directly-observed` folds into `strong`; Phase-1's `contrary` is renamed to the author's `counterexample`; `tension` is adopted from the author's set. A strength outside this set reddens (IC1). The `not-described` != absent gloss is load-bearing and reproduced in the Ch-6 matrix caption when the prose wave places it.

correspondence.gloss: Clear correspondence; the source's behavior maps cleanly onto the construct. Not to be confused with proof.
The construct is instantiated in part; a named piece is missing. Not to be confused with strong.
The source is silent. Absence from a report is NOT evidence the company lacks it. Not to be confused with tension or counterexample.
MAGE's vocabulary fits the site awkwardly — the construct describes it only with contortion, but the site does not disconfirm it. Not to be confused with counterexample.
The source describes behavior that runs against the construct — genuine disconfirming evidence. Not to be confused with not-described or tension.

construct_universe._note: The declared, ORDERED column set for the correspondence matrix (REVISE-3). Its members are the MAGE construct universe the book induced — the two theses plus the theory constructs the DocAble case exercises. Columns are STABLE: a new case renders against this fixed set (append-a-row); a new construct is the rare deliberate event that widens it. IC3 checks every case's mage_constructs[].construct resolves here. Order is the column order render_matrix_md() emits.

docable_row._note: The fixed row-0 of the projected matrix — the book's OWN case, whose correspondence is hand-declared once here (not a roster member, not an industry_case record). DocAble is `strong` across the construct universe it induced; render_matrix_md() emits it first, then the authored external rows. This is the baseline against which external sparsity reads as coverage, not weakness.

roster._note: The declared six-site ROSTER — the purposive sample the book intends (author's §1.3 table verbatim). Counts DERIVE from this block (REVISE-1): IC6 checks the record-set id-set equals the roster id-set (and that shared roster fields agree between roster and record), so a silently added or dropped case reddens — a declared intent the author edits when authoring or adding a case, never a magic integer.

industry_cases.autonomous_work: Agents review code/design/incident artifacts and may withhold approval or block a merge on an unsatisfied enforced MUST; humans author, approve, and promote policy. Agents scale reach, not authority.
industry_cases.traceability: Stable requirement slug survives RFC edits (identity, not location); statements retain pointers back to originating RFC sections. LLM interprets applicability at review time — NOT a mechanical model<->implementation drift join.
industry_cases.context_strategy: Lazy/on-demand retrieval of relevant statements per merge request; representation compacted from Markdown to filtered JSON so agents pull only what applies.
industry_cases.agent_authority: Merge-block / approval-withhold on enforced statements; no autonomous policy change; promotion approved->enforced is human-gated.
industry_cases.feedback_adaptation: Representation evolution is automated (RFC change -> re-extract/compact); POLICY evolution is human-governed. Incident agent surfaces gaps but the source does NOT describe finding -> new obligation -> recurrence retired.
industry_cases.org_memory: Codex = curated RFC corpus as durable institutional knowledge outliving any engineer or team.
industry_cases.implicit_theory: The book reads Cloudflare as appearing to believe autonomous agents work when institutional standards are made machine-readable, given stable identities, retrieved at the point of work, and enforced by agents at review time.
